text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~... Hey.
I'm gonna crash on that sofa over there.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Nothing. Even a picture-perfect honor student
needs a break once in a while, right?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Well, if it's here, it's just you and me.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
And so, I'll be hanging around here for a while.
You just focus on your work.

Daiwa Scarlet seemed exhausted from academy life.
...Perhaps it's time to consider some rest and recovery.
